title: Head of Customer Success
description:
At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences.

As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito.

Are you ready to make an impact?

Your Mission:

Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth.

  • Lead by Example: You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed.

  • Team Development & Coaching: You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup.

  • Escalations & Problem Solving: You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy.

  • Process & Project Innovation: You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage.

  • Commercial Impact & Growth: You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

  • Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

Your Story

You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesses - all fueled by a real enthusiasm for the magic of event tech.

  • SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment.

  • Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation.

  • Effective Communicator: You are a skilled communicator and workshop facilitator who connects effortlessly with enterprise executives, end-users and internal teams alike.

  • Tech Savvy and Agile: You are at home analyzing usage data, mapping workflows and collaborating with Product on technical escalations. You adapt quickly to new software, shifting priorities and changing processes.

  • Leadership Drive: You genuinely care about people. Ideally, you have led a small team before and take true fulfillment in coaching others, building confidence and helping your team grow.

  • Passion for Events and Tech: Events are all about emotion and experience. We are looking for someone who brings that exact enthusiasm for events, event tech and / or digital products.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German, with the ability to comfortably follow Swiss-German in client meetings.

What We Offer

Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins.

  • Impact: Take ownership of a role where your work directly shapes evenito's growth and sets new standards for the industry. You will work closely with management, an amazing team, passionate clients and drive projects that make a difference.

  • Flexibility: As one of our core values, we strongly believe in hybrid remote work options and flexible schedules that allow you to align your professional commitments with your personal life.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge.

  • Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots.

  • Unique Events: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties.

  • Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting.

  • Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop.

Are you ready to shape the future of events with us?

Discover more about life at evenito on our career page, send us your CV and tell us what excites you most about joining our team. We are building something special at evenito - and we can’t wait to meet the person behind the application.

Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte.   • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)

  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

description:
About this position

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

Your tasks:

  • Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

  • Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

  • Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

  • Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

  • Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

  • Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

  • Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

  • Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

Role requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

  • Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment.

  • Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model.

  • Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

  • Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

  • Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Work permit

Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland

If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients.

title: Senior Projectmanager
description:

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. title: Senior iOS Developer
description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow

  • Coding / AI assisted coding interview
  • Mobile System Design Interview
  • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

A plus

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Ben jij een Senior Mechanical Engineer die impact wil maken in één van de meest kritische technische omgevingen? Binnen onze unit Airports werk je aan hoogwaardige projecten die direct bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en duurzame luchthaveninfrastructuur. Je combineert technische diepgang met overzicht en neemt een sleutelrol in complexe projecten.

De uitdaging 

In deze rol ben jij de inhoudelijke werktuigbouwkundige spil binnen complexe luchthavenprojecten, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Je opereert midden in de luchthavenoperatie, waar veiligheid, continuïteit en kwaliteit leidend zijn. Je neemt het voortouw in het ontwikkelen van slimme, integrale installatietechnische oplossingen en adviseert opdrachtgevers op strategisch en conceptueel niveau.


Werken in een 24uurs luchthavenomgeving maakt deze rol bijzonder dynamisch en uitdagend. De complexiteit van zowel de klant als de situatie vraagt om flexibiliteit, snel schakelen en creatief denken. Juist deze afwisseling zorgt ervoor dat geen dag hetzelfde is.


Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Je ontwerpt en adviseert zelfstandig over complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen luchthavenprojecten en vertaalt ontwerpen van schets tot technische uitwerking in AutoCAD en BIM. Je zet BIM‑structuren op en begeleidt en corrigeert junior collega’s.

  • Het inhoudelijk bijdragen aan conceptontwikkeling en het vertalen van ontwerpuitgangspunten naar haalbare en integrale oplossingen.

  • Het uitvoeren en controleren van berekeningen en het beoordelen van het werk van engineers en technici.

  • Het afstemmen met projectleiders, ontwerpers, andere disciplines en externe partijen over technische keuzes en randvoorwaarden.

  • Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen in kwaliteit, planning en budget en hierover proactief schakelen binnen het projectteam.

  • Het begeleiden, coachen en inhoudelijk ondersteunen van junior engineers binnen projecten.

  • Het leveren van input voor rapportages, adviezen en offertes.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en kwaliteitsverbetering binnen de afdeling Airports.

De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn

  • We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. Dit moet zorgen voor een aangename passagiersbeleving maar ook voor het aanbieden van een prettig werkklimaat voor de medewerkers op Schiphol, rekening houdend met hun dagelijkse activiteiten.

  • We werken aan het nieuwe operationele gebouw van DC ANSP, de luchtverkeersleiding van het Nederlandse luchtruim in de Cariben. Dit is een faciliteit voor de luchtverkeersleiders die verantwoordelijk zijn voor area control, waarbij de operations room en de ruimte waar de apparatuur staat opgesteld aan strenge bouwfysische en klimaateisen moeten voldoen met een hoge mate van redundantie. De omgeving vraagt daarnaast om een robuust ontwerp dat bestand is tegen orkanen en aardbevingen.

  • We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. Schiphol is een unieke klant om voor te werken, vanwege de omvang van de luchthaven, de continue operationele eisen en de aanwezigheid van verschillende beveiligingszones. Wij worden veel ingezet om de oorzaak van klachten te achterhalen en de juiste oplossing te bieden, of om de juiste oplossing te vinden voor nieuwe apparatuur die hogere eisen stelt aan de installaties. Vrijwel altijd gaat het hier om locaties waar zich passagiers bevinden en Schiphol deze een comfortabele omgeving wil bieden, of waar medewerkers taken uitvoeren die essentieel zijn voor het primaire proces van de luchthaven, waarbij een prettig klimaat een belangrijke voorwaarde is.

 

Team

Je werkt in een team van collega’s binnen een organisatie met ruim 750 medewerkers, actief in verschillende sectoren. Het hechte airports team bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers en specialisten in airportsystemen. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over luchthavenoperaties, gebouwgebonden installaties en specifieke luchthavensystemen. De cultuur is open en gericht op het delen van kennis en werkplezier. Je maakt deel uit van een integraal projectteam waarin ieders expertise optimaal wordt benut, wat zorgt voor sterke samenwerking en persoonlijke groei. De unit Airports werkt voor luchthavens in binnen- en buitenland, waardoor je aan diverse projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is.
 
Dit ben jij 

  • Mbo-, hbo- of wo‑werk- en denkniveau, met een afgeronde opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Installatietechniek of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Ook kandidaten met een mbo‑achtergrond en ruime relevante werkervaring aan de ontwerpkant nodigen wij nadrukkelijk uit om te reageren.  

  • Enkele jaren ervaring binnen de gebouwde omgeving, bij voorkeur in een ontwerp of engineeringsrol.

  • Goede technische basis en inzicht in het ontwerp en uitvoeringsproces.

  • Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld luchthaven-, winkelcentra, grote kantoren of ziekenhuisprojecten is een pré.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling.

  • Gestructureerde en zorgvuldige manier van werken, met oog voor kwaliteit en planning.

  • Samenwerkingsgericht en in staat om zelfstandig én in teamverband te werken.

  • Vaardig in of bereid om zich te ontwikkelen in gangbare tools en systemen (MS 365, AutoCad, Revit, ontwerp- en rekenprogramma’s).

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en goede beheersing van het Engels

 

Dit bieden wij 

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. 

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. 

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. 

 

Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work!

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together

We'll build this together, side by side in our Münster office. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. Got questions before you apply? Just message me on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/diana-pashaian-1637133b2/

03 · What you'll do

  • Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself.

  • Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network.

  • Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no.

  • Steer by numbers: Always know where the funnel gets stuck – and turn the right dials.

  • Get us seen: Shape how RIZM is perceived as an employer – careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships.

title: TYPO3 Developer
description:
TYPO3 Developer
(Mensch)

Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten?

Zur Übersicht

Der ultimative TYPO3-Check

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du…

  • … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst, die es wirklich braucht.

  • … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren.

  • … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest.

  • … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht.

  • … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben. Auch nicht „nur schnell“.

… dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du

Worum geht es?

Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen.

Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist?

Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert.

Und was ist mit KI?

Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist.

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites.

  • Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates.

  • Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran.

  • Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich.

Beratung und Support

  • Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur.

  • Du bearbeitest Kunden-Tickets und Support-Anfragen, die unser First-Level-Support nicht direkt lösen kann.

  • Du übersetzt Technik in Kunden-Deutsch und Kundenwünsche in saubere Technik.

Was bringst du mit?

  • 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3.

  • Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML.

  • Du beherrschst den Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken, zum Beispiel MariaDB.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab.

Wäre gut,
aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit WordPress.

  • Erfahrung mit Solr oder Elasticsearch.

  • Praxis mit Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps-Methoden.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes

  • Infrastruktur: Eigene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung mit technologischem Freiraum, in der Entwicklung und im Live-Betrieb

  • Starkes Netzwerk: Als Teil der team neusta Gruppe hast du kurze Wege zu über 800 Expert:innen, wenn dein Projekt zusätzliche Spezialpower braucht.

  • Zeitraum: ab sofort

Interesse?

Wir verzichten auf klassische Anschreiben.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und gerne 2 bis 3 kurze Beispiele aus deinen TYPO3-Projekten: TYPO3-Version, Umfang des Projekts, deine Rolle, größte technische Herausforderung.

Und ein Satz dazu, wie du KI beim Entwickeln einsetzt, hilft uns sehr.

Teilst du uns dabei auch deinen Gehaltswunsch und deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit? Das wäre prima.

Nutzen Sie den Button auf dieser Seite für Ihre Bewerbung.

Unser Team, deine Vorteile

Wir bei NetFed sind davon überzeugt, dass es ein gutes Arbeitsklima und gegenseitige Wertschätzung benötigt, um produktiv arbeiten zu können. Unsere Erfolgsformel für NetFed-Wachstum heißt deshalb: Wir schaffen gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeiter:innen ein optimales Arbeitsumfeld, das Spaß und Leidenschaft bei der Arbeit ermöglicht und gleichzeitig genügend Spielraum für das Privatleben lässt.

Das sind unsere Vorteile:

  • Fort- und Weiterbildung

  • Family Life Balance

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Homeoffice

  • Freiwillige Sozial­leistungen

  • Urban Sports Club

Lust auf mehr? Unser Team stellt sich dir gerne persönlich vor.

title: Senior Fraud & Risk Analyst (f/m/x)
description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.

With 50M+ platform downloads, we’re rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps players discover, and engage with games they enjoy - creating lasting value for both players and gaming studios.

As a Senior Fraud Analyst, you'll join our Fraud Analytics team as a close partner to our Fraud Analytics Team Lead - someone who can operate independently, mentor other team members, and help shape the fraud and risk agenda as the team and company scale.

You'll work cross-functionally with different teams, dig into fraud patterns across our platform, and build the processes we don't have yet. It's a highly visible, high-ownership role in a fast-growing company.

What You'll Own:

  • Strategic partnership: Partner directly with the Fraud Analytics Team Lead on strategy, ideation, and day-to-day problem solving - acting as a sounding board, ready to step in and keep things moving when needed.
  • Reporting uplift: Drive the evolution of fraud and risk reporting, turning raw data into sharp, decision-ready insights.
  • Fraud trend analysis: Hunt down patterns across our user base, shape the detection logic and rules that keep us ahead of bad actors, monitor how those rules perform, and optimise them over time.
  • Process ownership: Own the design of fraud and risk processes end-to-end, spotting gaps and building what doesn't exist yet.
  • Experimentation: Test, learn, and iterate - running A/B tests to continuously sharpen our fraud prevention strategies.
  • Strategic thinking: Think beyond the day-to-day, helping define where fraud and risk management goes next as the team scales.
  • Mentorship & collaboration: Mentor teammates and partner cross-functionally with Tech, Data, Product, Support, and Finance - becoming a go-to person others rely on.

What You Bring

  • Fraud & risk experience: 5+ years in fraud, risk management, or a closely related financial risk function; direct fraud experience is a strong plus, ideally in gaming or another B2C/app-based industry.
  • Data & AI fluency: Comfort working with data - SQL, databases, and hands-on experience using AI tools for analysis and prompting.
  • Analytical mindset: Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort with numbers, paired with the ability to turn analysis into clear, actionable reporting.
  • Strategic contribution: Experience contributing to or developing risk/fraud strategy, not just executing existing processes — including running A/B tests to validate ideas.
  • Collaboration & mentorship: Experience mentoring or supporting colleagues, and working cross-functionally across different stakeholder perspectives.
  • Education: A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree (Business, Finance, Accounting, Data/Mathematics, Engineering, or similar).
  • Language: Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

  • Background in policy design or risk governance frameworks.
  • Relevant certifications such as CFE, CFCS, CAMS, CRISC, CFA, and/or FRM.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks - e.g. GDPR, PSD2/SCA, AML/KYC principles, and PCI-DSS basics where payment data is processed.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

  • Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest.

  • Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

 

Why we're hiring

Nous runs on small teams with real ownership and barely any middle management. That's a big part of how about 30 of us became one of the UK's fastest-growing startups. It also means the work of joining everything up has been spread across the founders and leads, squeezed in around their day jobs. Plans, OKRs, closing the hires that matter, the big company pushes: everyone does a bit of it and nobody owns it.

Last week showed what happens when someone does. We ran "crunch week": five days where most of the company dropped its normal work to relaunch Nous as a household agent. Twelve workstreams, one owner each, a short daily sync and a pre-mortem. In a week we rebuilt onboarding and the website, shipped new agent capabilities, and got legal, security and comms ready for launch. As one of the team said afterwards, when we cluster around a problem for a bit, we do loads of work.

We want that pace more of the time, without a founder having to drop everything to run it. So we're hiring a Chief of Staff.

 

About the role

You'll work directly with Greg (our CEO) and the founding team, and own how Nous runs day to day: the pace, planning and OKRs, and the big company pushes, plus overseeing hiring and helping land the hires that matter most. You'll sit in the management meeting and get the full picture, including the things that aren't public yet. And you'll have the authority to change how we work: cancel or reshape meetings, and move people and cut scope during a big push.

You enjoy coordinating, but only because it gets things done faster. You'd rather get a decision made today than design a process for making decisions.

 

What you'll actually do

  • Set the pace. Spot what's stuck, work out why, and get it moving. Usually it's a decision nobody has made yet, so you get it made, or make it yourself.

  • Own planning and OKRs. Quarterly OKRs, the weekly management meeting, planning and offsites. Squads run pretty autonomously; you make sure they're working to the same priorities. Each of these should take up less of everyone's time with you running it, not more.

  • Own the scorecard. Keep the numbers behind our OKRs current, and say each week what's off track and why. You pull the data yourself (SQL, our BI tool, a spreadsheet) rather than chasing people for updates.

  • Run the big pushes. The next crunch week is yours: scope it with the leadership team, pick the owners, run it, and write up what we'd do differently next time.

  • Oversee hiring, and help close the hires that matter. Hiring managers run their own processes, and you won't be running ten of them. But you'll keep an eye on all of them, know where every search stands, and jump in where needed. Mostly that's closing the people we really want: working out what they care about and how to win them. Sometimes it's getting a recruiter excited about working with Nous, or unsticking a process that's gone quiet.

  • Represent Nous. You'll talk to recruiters and senior candidates from day one. Over time, and where it helps, you'll represent us to partners, suppliers and investors too.

  • Automate the boring bits. You'd rather build the Monday status digest with Claude than write it by hand every week. Anything you find yourself doing every week is a candidate for automating.

 

What this role isn't

  • An assistant. Diaries and inboxes are someone else's job.

  • A process role. If your first instinct is a new meeting, template or tracker, this probably won't suit you. With you here we should have fewer recurring meetings, not more.

  • A product role. Squads own what gets built, and strategy stays with the founders. You'll be in the room for both, and you make sure nobody's blocked.

  • A recruiter. You oversee hiring and step in where it matters; hiring managers still run their own processes.

  • A dumping ground for jobs nobody else wants. You'll pick up odd jobs, as everyone here does, but the bulk of the role is above.

 

What success looks like

In your first 90 days:

  • The company runs noticeably better: decisions get made faster and fewer things stall. Ask the leads and they'd say so.

  • Something that had been stuck for weeks has shipped because you got involved.

  • You've helped close at least one hire we really wanted.

  • Next quarter's OKRs are set, and the scorecard is current every week.

  • At least one piece of weekly coordination (the OKR update, the status round-up) runs as an AI workflow you built, and nobody does it by hand any more.

  • We have fewer recurring meetings than when you joined.

After a year:

  • You've led two or three company-wide pushes that shipped what they set out to.

  • The senior hires you helped close have said yes and are doing well.

  • Planning, OKRs and the weekly meetings run fine for a month without you.

  • Most of the routine coordination runs on workflows and tools you built, not on meetings.

 

About you

You've got 4–7 years behind you (perhaps a little more if you've switched careers), probably a mix of a fast-growing startup and somewhere that taught you structure: consulting, BizOps or strategy and ops at a scale-up, a founder's office, or product work where you ran launches across teams. Maybe you've founded something.

You coordinate because you're impatient. You notice the thing that's been stuck for a week, and you're the one who unsticks it.

You're persuasive. You can work out what a candidate is really optimising for and how to close them, get a busy recruiter excited about Nous, and hold your own with senior people outside the company.

You're comfortable with numbers. You can build a quick model, write a bit of SQL or find the right dashboard, and tell a real trend from noise.

AI tooling is already how you work. Claude, Claude Code or similar is where you get things done, not something you tried once.

You write clearly and quickly. Most of this job happens in writing: kick-off notes, weekly updates, closing emails.

You tell people the truth, founders included, and you keep confidences. You'll see salaries, plans and people issues before anyone else does.

You listen and you care, but you don't do politics. This role has more connective tissue with others than anyone else in the business, so by playing it straight and being an honest broker, you are also establishing an important norm.

Low ego. Some of the job is unglamorous and you do it anyway.

Bonus points:

  • You've closed hard candidates, or worked in recruiting, talent or BD.

  • You've run a company planning cycle, an offsite or a launch end to end.

  • You've worked somewhere regulated (energy, fintech, insurance).

  • You've automated a chunk of your own job and have something to show for it.

  • You are commercially astute or professionally experienced in a deep domain like law or accounting.

 

How you will grow

This might not be a forever role, and that's fine. You'll see more of how a fast-growing company works than almost anyone else here, which tends to open doors: running a new category as we expand, leading a function, or a commercial or operations role. Or the role grows with the company. Either way, we'll talk about it properly once you've been here a year.

 

Remuneration and benefits

Compelling packages, including share options with life-changing upside. We've raised enough money to pay real salaries. We're building something great together and we all share in the upside. If we win, we win together.

An environment where you can do your best work:

  • 🏢 A great office set up for lots of collaborative working. We already need more whiteboards

  • 💻 The equipment / setup / training you need to do your best work (and of course, AI subscriptions, including Claude Code Max tier)

  • 🤝 A high-context environment with lots of exposure to the big decisions - be in the room when it happens (literally)

  • 🏡 Flexibility around remote work. If you sometimes just need to get your head down, that's fine

  • ☕ Very good coffee

  • 🍽️ A well-stocked kitchen (featuring a wildly popular toastie maker) so you can always make yourself a breakfast or light lunch on the house

  • 🎉 Informal social every week, something bigger every month, plus a set-piece event in the summer and again at Christmas - we're not robots!

  • ✈ 33 days paid holidays (including bank holidays)

  • 💊 Health and dental cash plans, including an employee assistance programme

  • 🚴 Travel benefits, including the cycle-to-work scheme and season ticket loans

Nous has an office-first culture. That means we encourage in-person working, and most people do work from the office in Farringdon most of the time. We do a lot of brainstorming, problem-solving and interaction within the team and presence makes this more effective. It also helps ensure people have good peripheral awareness and high context. But we are pragmatic not doctrinal about this, and recognise that, sometimes, certain types of work can be better done remotely. Most team members spend 3-4 days a week in the office on average. This role may naturally involve even more presence than that.

 

The environment

Most importantly, this is a high-performance, high-agency and high-trust technical environment. Nous is intentionally lean and AI-native, not just in its product but as a company. Everyone is expected to use AI to its full potential, whether that's debugging a system, streamlining a workflow or improving how customers are served. Rather than building layers of middle management, we hire smart, high-agency people and give them real ownership.

We're dedicated to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace, and we actively welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Every candidate is thoughtfully considered, without regard to race, religion, gender expression, disability or sexual orientation.

If you don't tick every box but think you'd be great at this, get in touch anyway.

So we're after PMs who are excited by everything it takes to make an agentic product work for real households, including the bits that wouldn't traditionally count as "product".

Worth being upfront: we can't tell you yet which service lines you'd own. It depends on the Venn diagram of your particular skill set and the problems we need to solve at the point you join.

 

What matters most

  • Commercial and analytical. You know what your area made last month, what moved it and what you'd do next, and you answer most of your own questions with data. You think in conversion, margin and lifetime value as readily as in features.

  • Energy. You've probably worked at a startup. You move fast, you're happy doing the unglamorous work yourself, and you'd rather ship this week's version than polish next quarter's.

And everyone builds here, PMs included. You'll use AI tooling (Claude Code or whatever gets it done) to prototype, dig into data and ship changes yourself. You don't need to be an engineer, but you shouldn't be scared of code.

 

What you'll actually do

  • Set the squad's OKRs and roadmap, get the sequencing in place, and drive fast, efficient execution.

  • Work across product and commercial: the suppliers and tariffs we can offer, the regulation we work within, and what that means for what gets built.

  • Run experiments, and unblock yourself on the analysis without always needing an analyst.

About you

This probably isn't for you if your PM experience is mostly roadmaps and stakeholder management at a big company, with no number you owned.

 

How we work

We keep the middle thin, on purpose. There's barely any middle management, which means fewer bottlenecks and room for exceptional people to have real impact without first being promoted into managing others. It's a real bet, not a free lunch. Instead of a manager buffer, you get lots of context and colleagues who help because they're invested, not because an org chart says so. If you need a clear remit handed down before you can move, this probably won't suit you.

Your first 90 days are built around getting you to real ownership safely: pairing when you want it, lots of context, and people who want you to ship. We celebrate the person who built the unglamorous version this week, not whoever thought of it first.

We're office-first, near Farringdon. We do a lot of our best thinking together and being in the same room helps, though we're pragmatic about heads-down work when you need it.

description:
Contexte

Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingénierie@Lyon, propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux.

Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique.

Cas d’étude

Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes.


Profil recherché

Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés.

Type de contrat

Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois.

title: Product Line Manager

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.
